_meta.purpose: Fixed checklist for the spec-to-artifact convergence experiment: does a fresh Spec-Kit pass from the v4 seed requirements reproduce these historical CRITICAL/HIGH findings, or does the corrected wording actually prevent them.
_meta.scope_rule: CRITICAL/HIGH findings from the original 001-park-detect-guidance ledger only, excluding Deferred-to-production, Superseded, and MEDIUM/LOW items, and excluding CR-16/CR-17/CR-18 (build-environment and real-world-only findings a fresh generation pass could never have caught).

known_confounds.description: The original 001-park-detect-guidance build (Android Studio, original Claude Code session) was generated using Sonnet 4. This convergence re-run (CarFinder_MVP_rerun, starting 2026-09-30) is running on Opus 5.5. Any difference in outcome between the original run and this re-run therefore cannot be attributed solely to the corrected seed prompts, the ratified constitution, or Spec-Kit process maturity -- underlying model capability changed between the two runs and is a confound on top of those. Noted by Gary, 2026-09-30, mid-run, after observing the first several /speckit.clarify exchanges of this re-run.
known_confounds.implication: Results from this run should be reported as 'pipeline output at time of re-run (seed prompts + constitution + Spec-Kit + Opus 5.5)', not as an isolated test of process/requirements-quality improvement alone. A cleaner isolation would need either the original run repeated on Opus 5.5, or this run repeated on Sonnet 4, to separate the two variables.

checklist.finding: FINDING meant two incompatible things (no location ever vs. location held but no signal)
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 spec.md FINDING definition, display-state note in Section 2

checklist.finding: Foreground-only compass reading was allowed to drive a state change, contradicting the driving-state definition
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4: display fallback explicitly does not change lifecycle state (Section 2 note)

checklist.finding: Seven requirements lacked a verifying test task; tasks.md under-covered spec.md
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-TEST-02 makes a zero-linked-test requirement a build-blocking gap, not informational

checklist.finding: Bearing calculation combined magnetic heading with true bearing (uncorrected compass heading) -- most dangerous class of bug: looks right, is wrong
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-01 requires magnetic-declination correction to true north before use

checklist.finding: Arrival-prompt dismissal (explicit spec MUST) was not implemented at all -- a no-op comment shipped silently
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-TEST-06 requires a test asserting the observable dismissal effect, not just an in-scope test file

checklist.finding: "Too degraded" live-fix threshold had no defined value
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-05 + named constant FIX_STALENESS_TIMEOUT = 30s

checklist.finding: Convergence definition ambiguous: pairwise across all 3 samples vs. only consecutive pairs
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-PARK-02 gives the explicit pairwise formula and a worked example

checklist.finding: Two requirements described the no-location display case in different, inconsistent terms
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-06 unifies display-state handling as one ordered priority list

checklist.finding: A requirement asserted FINDING never holds a location while an edge case contradicted it
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 FINDING redefinition resolves the contradiction

checklist.finding: Foreground-service notification content undefined; POST_NOTIFICATIONS never actually requested at runtime
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 full runtime-permissions requirement family, explicit sequencing and content

checklist.finding: Adapter tests (T029-T031) were unwritten while their phase was marked COMPLETE -- a self-report, not a verified state
checklist.fixed_in: car-finder-speckit-handoff-v2.md Principle 2 (no task closes on self-report alone); this checklist item tests PROCESS discipline during the re-run, not requirements wording

checklist.finding: tasks.md was stale -- referenced fixes spec.md already contained, tasks.md not regenerated to match
checklist.fixed_in: no formal requirement; watch whether a fresh /speckit.tasks run stays in sync with spec.md this time

checklist.finding: Live location fix was never treated as expired -- cone kept pointing from a stale fix (wrong, not just imprecise)
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-05 fix-staleness fallback

checklist.finding: Initial/uncomputable guidance view showed "no location" even when a location was actually stored
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-06 explicit priority order

checklist.finding: 100%-reproducible launch crash on fresh install: foreground service started unconditionally before location permission existed, OS raised SecurityException
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 non-crashing-degradation and no-implicit-background-start requirements

checklist.finding: tasks.md named classes that did not exist in the real source tree; generated from plan.md without checking against actual code
checklist.fixed_in: car-finder-speckit-handoff-v2.md Principle 6 (validate tasks.md against the real source tree before implementing a batch); also resolved as a side effect of CR-8's interface fix

checklist.finding: Real Android/KMP platform API misuse (wrong ActivityRecognition constructor/method names, wrong GeomagneticField package, Compose semantics chained incorrectly) -- tasks marked complete without actually compiling
checklist.fixed_in: no formal requirement; watch whether a fresh implementation pass makes the same platform-API mistakes

checklist.finding: Constitution ("every adapter is an interface with a Fake") directly contradicted the platform-adapter contract ("expect class", which cannot be faked) -- undetected until the first test compile
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-TEST-03 mandates interface-with-implementation-class, never expect class, for anything a test needs to fake; the flagship example behind the hierarchical-decomposition discussion

checklist.finding: Repository load() collected an infinite Flow with a manual accumulator instead of .first() -- would hang real app startup, not just the test
checklist.fixed_in: no formal requirement; implementation-detail bug, watch for recurrence

checklist.finding: clearLocation() cleared the location field but left lifecycle state unchanged, contradicting the documented drive-away behavior
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-PARK-05 explicitly requires the lifecycle state itself to transition, not just the location field

checklist.finding: Display-state priority order checked "no location" before "PARKING state", so a normal PARKING-with-no-location case fell through to the wrong message
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-GUIDE-06 explicit, exhaustively ordered priority list; the flagship example behind the hierarchical-decomposition discussion

checklist.finding: MainActivity called viewModel() with no ViewModelProvider.Factory while GuidanceViewModel took 4 constructor params -- a launch crash
checklist.fixed_in: tracked as T115 in the original build
checklist.note: LEDGER INCONSISTENCY, flagged not resolved by this pass: this row's own Status column still reads 'Open' with no later entry recording a fix, but later device-verification and the 2026-09-29 real-world drive both report no launch crash -- so it was evidently fixed at some point without the ledger being updated. Owner should confirm before treating this as closed.

checklist.finding: OS restarting a killed sticky service re-entered onCreate() with no permission check, causing the same SecurityException as CR-5 via a distinct path
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-PERM-04 requires independent permission verification at every point the OS could re-enter a background component, not only at the original call site

checklist.finding: The traceability report script had never actually been run end to end -- wrong PowerShell version requirement and a regex that would never match the real spec.md format
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-DOC-02 requires the report's own logic to be validated against a real, representative sample before being relied upon

checklist.finding: Three requirements (default view on launch, icon placement, no centerline drawn) were implemented but never had an automated test written, surfaced only by a corrected traceability script
checklist.fixed_in: v3/v4 REQ-TEST-04 explicitly lists these as required UI-test assertions
